subject: My application for Data Analyst
body:
Hello,

I applied last week. Could you tell me what the status of my application is?

Thanks,
Sam

subject: Anything else needed?
body:
Good morning,

Is there anything else you need from me for the HR Coordinator role?

Best regards,
Omar

subject: Interview details
body:
Hi,

Could you remind me when and where my interview is?

Thank you,
Priya

subject: Any decision yet?
body:
Hello,

Have you made a decision about my application?

Kind regards,
Leo

subject: Update on the UX Designer role
body:
Hello,

I would appreciate an update on my application.

Best,
Hana

subject: Salary range
body:
Hi,

What salary does the Data Analyst role pay?

Thanks,
Sam

subject: Re: Interview details
body:
Hi again,

Something came up. Could we move my interview to another day?

Priya

subject: Withdrawing my application
body:
Hello,

I have accepted another position, so I would like to withdraw my application.

Thank you for your time,
Omar

subject: Open positions
body:
Hello,

I have not applied yet. Do you have any open positions?

Morgan

subject: Portfolio for the Data Analyst role
body:
Hello,

I have just finished the portfolio you asked for. Should I send it to this address or upload it somewhere?

Best,
Sam

subject: Interview on Wednesday
body:
Hi Nadia,

Thank you for the invitation. Could you confirm the time of my interview on Wednesday and whether I should prepare anything specific?

Kind regards,
Amira

subject: Remote work for the Backend Engineer role
body:
Hello,

I applied for the Backend Engineer position. Is the role open to remote work, or is it based in the Tunis office?

Thanks,
Lucas Moreau

subject: Next steps after the SQL test
body:
Dear recruiting team,

I completed the SQL exercise last Friday. When can I expect to hear about the next steps?

Thank you,
Yasmine

subject: Feedback on my application
body:
Hello,

I received the email saying the HR Coordinator role is no longer available. Could you share any feedback on my profile for future openings?

Regards,
Daniel

subject: Need to move my interview
body:
Hi,

I am very sorry, but I have a medical appointment on Friday morning that I cannot move. Would it be possible to reschedule my interview to another day next week?

Best regards,
Sofia Rossi

subject: References
body:
Hello,

You asked for references. My two former managers agreed to be contacted. Do you need a letter from them, or are names and phone numbers enough?

Thanks,
Karim

subject: Application for the Frontend Developer position
body:
Hello,

I would like to apply for the Frontend Developer position I saw on your careers page. I have four years of experience with React and TypeScript. My CV is attached.

Best,
Ines Mansouri

subject: Candidature spontanée
body:
Bonjour,

Je souhaite proposer ma candidature pour un poste d'analyste de données. Vous trouverez mon CV en pièce jointe.

Cordialement,
Ahmed Gharbi

subject: Status of my Data Analyst application
body:
Hi,

I applied for the Data Analyst role two weeks ago and have not heard back yet. Is my application still being considered?

Thank you,
Jordan

subject: Salary range for Backend Engineer
body:
Hello again,

Could you tell me the salary range for the Backend Engineer role before we go further?

Thanks,
Lucas

subject: Deadline for the Data Analyst decision
body:
Hello,

I am writing about my Data Analyst application. I have another offer and need to answer them by Friday.

Best,
Leo

subject: Question about my leave balance
body:
Hi People Team,

How many days of annual leave do I have left this year? I would like to plan a week off in December.

Thanks,
Hana

subject: Training budget
body:
Hello,

Is there a training budget I can use for a cloud certification course? Who needs to approve it?

Thanks,
Tom

subject: Out of office
body:
Thank you for your email. I am travelling until 5 November with limited access to email. I will reply when I am back.

Priya Nair

subject: Exhibitor packages for the 2027 job fair
body:
Hello,

Registration is now open for exhibitors at our 2027 technology job fair. Packages start at a standard booth. Reply to this email to receive the brochure.

The Events Team

subject: Portfolio link
body:
Hi Nadia,

As promised, here is the updated portfolio with the two case studies we talked about. It is attached as a PDF.

Thanks again,
Amira

subject: Withdrawing from the process
body:
Hello,

After careful thought I have decided to accept another offer, so I would like to withdraw my application for the Backend Engineer role. Thank you for your time.

Kind regards,
Karim Jaziri

subject: Interview format
body:
Hi again,

One more question: will the interview include a design exercise, and should I bring my laptop?

Thanks,
Sofia

subject: Start date question
body:
Hello,

In case my application goes ahead, I wanted to mention that my notice period is one month. Would a start date in early January work for the team?

Best regards,
Yasmine
